elements.text: Revolutionize How You Engage and Dispatch Mobile Teams

Unity Dispatch is committed to revolutionizing how small businesses manage and dispatch vehicles. Rich mobile asset engagement improves retention, operational performance, and customer experience. We specialize in providing efficient situational awareness and exception management solutions for industries such as lawn mowing, HVAC repair, home health care, and cleaning services.
Our app offers optimized routing, dynamic resource allocation, and intelligence based client recruitment for efficient vehicle dispatch,saving time and fuel costs.
AI powered labor estimation, prospect engagement, field crew awareness, and real time sentiment analysis keep you out of the weeds and in the driver's seat.
We are interested in your success, not your data; keep your data secure and private with our tightly sandboxed solutions where you are in full control of your data assets.
Unity Dispatch offers a personalized experience, allowing you to tailor the app to your specific business needs.
Our snap-in cloud technology ensures seamless integration and secure accessibility from anywhere.

At Unity Dispatch, we believe in empowering small businesses through efficient vehicle management and dispatch solutions without replacing your existing operational systems. We specialize in providing intelligence, optimization, and stakeholder engagement solutions for industries such as lawn mowing, HVAC repair, home health care, and cleaning services. Our goal is to help businesses grow, improve
“Unity Dispatch has transformed the way we handle vehicle dispatch. It's a game-changer for our business.”
“The app's real-time support has been invaluable in addressing our on-field challenges effectively.”
"Unity's unique management by exception approach allowed us to grow by 100% in year one while allowing me to focus on our core values instead of chasing fires."
